title: 35 Ways to Use AI in Marketing (That Go Beyond Writing Captions) | LocaliQ

facts.fact: The LocaliQ blog post '35 Ways to Use AI in Marketing' was last updated on November 2, 2026.
LocaliQ's guide states that it details 35 ways to use AI in marketing across social media, paid advertising, and other channels.
facts.quote: In this guide, we’ve detailed 35 ways to use AI in marketing for social media, paid advertising, and more.

facts.fact: LocaliQ recommends picking three to five competitors to analyze for social media, including a couple outside your area.
facts.quote: Pick three to five competitors, including a couple outside your area that are great at social.

facts.fact: LocaliQ recommends exporting six to 12 months of post data from Meta Business Suite or a platform's analytics for analysis.
facts.quote: Export six to 12 months of post data from Meta Business Suite

facts.fact: LocaliQ suggests turning post-performance findings into three simple rules to guide future social posts.
facts.quote: Turn the answers into three simple rules

facts.fact: LocaliQ's own resource for AI in social media is a guide titled '14 No-Brainer Ways to Use AI for Social Media' that includes 20 prompts.
facts.quote: 14 No-Brainer Ways to Use AI for Social Media (+20 Prompts)

facts.fact: LocaliQ suggests spreading repurposed posts from one asset across the next two weeks so it covers two weeks of posts.
facts.quote: Edit, then spread the new posts across the next two weeks
